description: Builds a filled-in 7-section video editing brief (project, audience and goal, references, must-include moments, brand rules, deliverable specs, timeline) from whatever the user already knows, and lists the gaps an editor will ask about. Use when someone is about to hand footage to an editor, freelancer or agency. Pass only fields you know.

avoid.description: What not to copy: The traps to avoid

brand_files.description: Brand files: Lower-thirds, intro, outro, logo

captions.description: Captions: Burned in, SRT file, or both

channel.description: Channel or brand: Where it will be published

copy.description: What to copy: Pacing, captions, color, music, graphics

donts.description: Don'ts: Past mistakes not to repeat

feeling.description: How viewers should feel: The reaction you want at the end

fonts_colors.description: Fonts and colors: Font names and HEX codes

footage_location.description: Footage location: The folder link and what's in it

kill.description: KILL: Anything that can't be used

length_target.description: Length target: A target with a hard floor and ceiling

master.description: Master: Resolution, frame rate, audio level

metric.description: The one metric: What success means for this video

music.description: Music rules: Which library or tracks are licensed

must.description: MUST: Timestamps from the raw footage that have to land

nice.description: NICE-TO-HAVE: Moments to use if they fit

publish_date.description: Publish date: Date and time, not just a day

response_time.description: Response time: How fast you reply to a cut

revision_rounds.description: Revision rounds: How many, in writing

rough_cut_due.description: Rough cut due: Date and time

sensitive.description: SENSITIVE: Faces to blur, legal or private material

short_clips.description: Short clips: Number, ratio and length

sponsor.description: Sponsor read: Where it goes, if any

thumbnail_frames.description: Thumbnail frames: Frames to export as stills

working_title.description: Working title: The title you plan to publish, or the top two options

name: create_editing_brief
title: Create a video editing brief
